objective: Compare fixed Logistic Regression and LightGBM on identical point-in-time candidate demand-zone retest events, labels, chronological folds, and nested feature arms; estimate incremental contributions of context, demand-zone structure, and order-block structure.
estimand_scope: Predictive ranking conditional on one candidate demand-zone retest event per ticker-session in the recovered fixed 149-symbol roster. Not a causal effect, all-market scan, profitability test, or universal-market claim.

population.roster_source: Sorted distinct ticker values in outputs/v2/demand_zone_v2_dataset.csv; legacy rows, labels, and features are not used to construct study events, predictors, or outcomes.
population.universe_limitation: Fixed historical project roster; selection/survivorship and point-in-time membership are unresolved. Include delisted symbols if in roster; make no broad-market representativeness claim.
population.event_clock_start_rule: Replay zone and in-zone/out-of-zone state from the beginning of each cached OHLCV history, even before study_start_date; filter only candidate emissions by the study date. Truncate all histories at explicit as_of before any prospective feature construction.

event_definition.signal_timestamp: After close of daily bar T.
event_definition.pivot: Swing low at i if Low[i] is no greater than Low[i-1], Low[i-2], Low[i+1], and Low[i+2]; it is unavailable until the second following bar closes at i+2.
event_definition.zone_confirmation: The pivot becomes a zone at i+2. Zone price is Low[i]; width is ATR(14)[i]/Close[i]; formation and departure statistics use bars no later than i+2.
event_definition.retest: First bar in a contiguous run where abs(Low[T]-zone_price)/zone_price <= 0.03, with T strictly after zone confirmation. Each zone emits at most five retest starts; zones do not expire. Update in-zone/out-of-zone state for every zone on every session, including before study_start_date.
event_definition.same_ticker_date_deduplication: If several confirmed zones trigger on one ticker-date, retain one: highest known touch count, then smallest abs(Close[T]-zone_price)/zone_price, then lowest stable chronological zone id.
event_definition.event_id: Stable SHA-256 identifier of ticker plus signal calendar date; therefore one event per ticker-date, independent of which qualifying zone wins deduplication.
event_definition.feature_availability: All inputs for a signal-row feature are restricted to bars dated no later than T. A pivot's two right-hand bars are allowed only because the signal occurs after both have closed.
event_definition.label_maturity: Generate candidate events without looking at future labels. For supervised rows require the next two ticker trading bars and finite positive Open[T+1] and Open[T+2].

data.development_source: Local outputs/v2/_ohlcv daily OHLCV cache for the fixed roster and SPY, QQQ, IWM, and VIX (stored as XVIX.csv); use the exact local CSVs and record SHA-256 hashes and coverage.
data.roster_recovery_artifact: outputs/v2/demand_zone_v2_dataset.csv is used only to recover the sorted 149-ticker roster; its old event rows, features, and labels are not inputs to the controlled study.
data.price_adjustment_policy: Use the local Yahoo Finance-derived OHLCV snapshot as found. The V2 builder requested auto_adjust=True; cache-level point-in-time adjustment provenance and historical vendor revisions cannot be independently verified. Preserve and hash the exact local files. Retrospective metrics are development evidence only.
data.future_data_policy: Prospective prediction generation must truncate every security and benchmark history at the explicit signal date before feature construction; save per-event as-of-bar/source-prefix hashes. Never backfill predictions for dates on or before the model/protocol lock.

target.name: hold1_2pct
target.formula: hold1_ret[T] = Open[T+2] / Open[T+1] - 1; label[T] = 1 iff hold1_ret[T] >= 0.02, else 0.
target.entry: Open of the next ticker trading session T+1.
target.exit: Open of the following ticker trading session T+2.
target.missing_outcome_rule: Drop an event from supervised training/evaluation unless both forward opens and computed return are finite and strictly positive. Apply this validity mask before label conversion; missing outcomes are never negatives.
target.other_targets: No alpha, triple-barrier, wick-touch, 20-day, proxy, magnitude, or alternate-threshold labels in the primary study.

feature_timing_and_transforms.A: Derived from the security OHLCV at and before close[T]; normalized price ratios, trailing windows, and current-bar summaries only. ema_alignment remains missing until all three EMAs are finite.
feature_timing_and_transforms.B: ATR and realized-volatility windows end at T. SPY/QQQ/IWM/VIX are the latest bars dated no later than T; relative strength is stock trailing 20-session return minus benchmark trailing 20-session return. No sector map or forward benchmark holding return.
feature_timing_and_transforms.C: Selected zone is confirmed no later than T. Formation geometry uses only pivot-through-confirmation bars; current touch, age, distance, retest number, and freshness use history through T. No prior retest outcome statistics.
feature_timing_and_transforms.D: Use deterministic streaming CausalOrderBlockTracker v1 in backend/demand_zone_study_v1.py. It applies fixed 1% displacement, 0.6 ATR, 0.5 volume, up-to-three-bar OB, five-bar lookback, 90-calendar-day, and 100-session warmup rules on bars through T only; retain nearest unmitigated bullish and bearish blocks. Exclude HTF alignment, structure-break flag, future mitigation/outcome fields, and absolute price levels. This is a frozen causal study implementation, not a claim that the batch repository detector is prefix invariant.
feature_timing_and_transforms.missing_values: Keep exact rows across arms. Replace infinities with missing values; fit median imputation on training rows only and apply unchanged to validation/test. No missingness indicators or outcome-based feature selection. Logistic Regression additionally receives training-fold StandardScaler.

LogisticRegression.penalty: l2 (estimator default; omitted in code for sklearn 1.8+ compatibility)
LogisticRegression.pipeline: SimpleImputer(strategy=median, keep_empty_features=True) -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression; all fitted on training fold only.

LightGBM.pipeline: SimpleImputer(strategy=median, keep_empty_features=True) -> LGBMClassifier; imputer fit on training rows only.

estimators.selection: No hyperparameter search, ensemble, feature ranking, threshold selection, or result-driven changes in v1.

historical_development_evaluation.purge: For each fold, train only on rows whose target exit_date is strictly before the validation start. This enforces target maturity and keeps all same-ticker-date rows together.
historical_development_evaluation.historical_status: Every historical fold predates this lock and was available to earlier project development. The fresh replay is frozen and reproducible but remains retrospective development, not an untouched confirmation.
historical_development_evaluation.replay_cutoff: Emit candidate signal events from study_start_date up to (but excluding) the validation_end_exclusive date of the final historical_development_evaluation fold, derived from the fold table. Under v1.0.2 this is 2026-01-01: no signal events or feature rows dated in 2026 are emitted. Bars after the cutoff may be read solely to mature T+1/T+2 labels for eligible signal dates through 2025-12-31; final prospective model training additionally requires exit_date < 2026-01-01. Later cache bars are source coverage only, not prospective observations.
historical_development_evaluation.final_model_fit_cutoff: For the eight eventual prospective models, include only eligible rows with signal_date < 2026-01-01 AND exit_date < 2026-01-01, so every final training label matured before the cutoff.
metrics: equal-weight mean daily ROC-AUC on dates with both classes
mean top-5%-per-date precision beside same-date prevalence
historical_development_evaluation.uncertainty: Paired 95% percentile intervals for prespecified AUC contrasts using 1,000 circular moving-block bootstrap resamples of four consecutive calendar weeks, seed 42; descriptive historical uncertainty.
historical_development_evaluation.bootstrap_scope_note: The four-week blocks are sampled as specified, and all rows per sampled week retained; block draws are concatenated and the resulting pooled AUC contrast is recomputed. These intervals are descriptive; they are not a formal time-series inferential test.
historical_development_evaluation.constant_score_reference: A constant score has ROC-AUC 0.5 and provides the chance reference; no additional fitted model arm.

prospective_evaluation.fit_rule: After protocol, source, input snapshots, feature code, test suite, and all eight fitted development-only model pipelines are hash-locked, freeze models for prospective predictions; no retraining/tuning on prospective outcomes.
prospective_evaluation.first_signal_rule: First eligible close on a New York trading date strictly after the recorded UTC lock timestamp and after the latest date in the locked source snapshot. Do not backfill. Successful no-candidate runs are retained but do not start the duration clock; clock starts at the first successfully logged eligible prediction event.
prospective_evaluation.event_cap_policy: At most 2,000 unique event predictions. On a date that exceeds the remaining cap, keep the first events after stable sort by signal date then ticker, recording omissions. Once the cap is reached, log no later predictions and wait until at least 12 calendar months from the first eligible prediction before the single final analysis; if fewer than 2,000 valid outcomes mature, report the shortfall.
prospective_evaluation.stopping_rule: Stop predictions at the first of (a) 2,000 eligible unique ticker-date events or (b) the 18-calendar-month boundary. A final inferential analysis is permitted only after both 12 calendar months and 2,000 eligible matured event outcomes are available. If 2,000 eligible predictions mature before 12 months, keep the test sealed until month 12. If fewer than 2,000 events are accrued by month 18, report the actual matured count and limited precision, with no post-window additions. No result-dependent early stopping.
prospective_evaluation.retraining: None during this locked prospective test. Any code, data policy, feature, or model change requires a new version and prospective period.
prospective_evaluation.ledger: Append-only hash-chained JSONL predictions and outcomes. Persist eligible feature vectors, all eight scores, timestamp/as-of provenance, successful no-candidate runs, failures, and outcomes only after maturity. Only successfully logged eligible prediction events start the 12–18-month clock.

reproducibility.feature_selection: None beyond the fixed exact whitelist.
required_assertions: valid finite positive forward-open labels before binarization
same event_id/date/label set across all eight combinations
nested A subset B subset C subset D
training label exits strictly before validation start
no banned outcome/forward feature names in X
record code/data/universe/feature/model hashes and package versions
